Raised and independently reproduced2026-10-07 America/Los_Angeles by Auditor `01a10892-0782-7b13-902c-d8b4db6c155d`.

Affected PR #1144, exact merge `e4edec12c7238be7a803cd01bf264ee0ac840aea`, head `fdada431706a43aeea31c5df89afb1f5664632ae`; intended frozen comparison baseline `09c2dcff4f5acd92936fdd49378dd563332a1187`. Closed #1138 corrected #969/#431 source interpretation and stays closed. This is a new bounded producer-integrity remainder, not a reopening of source acquisition or boundary research.

Confirmed in `data/regional-review/texas-source-interpretation-followup-431/reproduce.py`:
1. The actual producer reads historical rows, source GeoJSON, retrieval manifest, metadata and local issue contract from the mutable checkout, without comparing their consumed complete bytes to the declared immutable baseline and manifest pins. In an isolated complete fixture, swap only the first two scoped rows' 2018 and2025 Census GEOIDs. Preserve all254 unique subject IDs,254unique GEOIDs, names, geometry types and component distribution. The unchanged actual CLI exits0, writes all254rows, and falsely associates Panola's Atlas/native identity/name with the other county's GEOID. Actual changed table SHA256 `153501f23675413441e16a4442a4d57b53d4d4a61444317cc8a5164a550f766d`; summary remains SHA `31f533b2fb485f71beb34599b343ece2b769d9e0f12f7efc58c10385620bcb45`. It checks only that each GEOID exists and both source types are Polygon, not that source record identity/name corresponds to the fixed county. Expected: authenticate actual full consumed row/source/code/scope bytes and independently validate each exact subject/source/county/GEOID join, reject conflicts before output. This is acceptance of corrupt evidence, not proof committed joins are wrong.
2. In the complete Census retrieval manifest, change only the2018query URL's `outSR=4326` to `outSR=3857`. Keep every source coordinate/feature, ID and service metadata unchanged. The real CLI exits0, includes the changed URL but still asserts `requested_output_crs:"EPSG:4326 (outSR parameter)"`. Actual summary SHA256 `e4c7097dc73269f0093327b7c5b4b35e9cf3c29ff0c60568942b3ed5a0fee111`. Expected: guard immutable retrieval bytes and parse/validate the actual request CRS and response/native declarations rather than hardcoding a requested CRS independent of the recorded parameter. Do not infer actual coordinate displacement from this synthetic metadata control.
3. Both result writers truncate/replace existing files (`open("w")`, `write_text`). An unchanged actual CLI in owned private fixtures replaces both preexisting table/summary sentinels and exits0. Default documented outputs are retained historical originals. Expected: admit a wholly new named output/run namespace exclusively before any write; reject existing files/directories/symlinks/path escapes and preserve prior successes/failures.
4. Per-row GEOID checks occur after opening the table for truncating writes. In a complete fixture change only the lexicographically last county's2018 GEOID to a missing key; the real CLI exits1 with KeyError after replacing the old table with253partial rows (308618B, SHA `3e08a02336a7e6d5fe1c25c890bedf6d433fabf81bae8e31b49aabf9cd72c63f`), while the old summary remains unchanged. Reject every consumed-input/identity/CRS inconsistency before output; preserve a failed new run honestly and do not install a complete publication/success record. A duplicate-subject control correctly rejects before writing and preserves both sentinels; retain this existing behavior.

Actual verification: all12added whole files665036B/head-merge equal;32baseline/output descriptors and5metric bindings match. Independently checked exact254scope and4572 identity/source/parent/GEOID/type/classification/component fields against historical rows, all254 Atlas features in the three pinned containing parts, original native members and both complete TIGERweb responses. No committed county join is wrong. Independently parsed actual raw ZIP central directory, DBF3233records and complete bounded16,869,220BShapefile plus527,301BDBF without a geometry-library reprojection; all254Texas records match names/GEOIDs/components/type:243single components plus11multipart records with70components,313total, no hole rings. Exact165B.prj declaresNAD83/GRS1980; retained GeoJSON CRS84 and actual outSR4326 requests distinguished from complete102100/3857 service CRS metadata, including original tolerance/origin fields. The first audit-only CRS checker incorrectly compared full dictionaries to two-key expectations; corrected full-value comparison passes, no packet defect inferred from that mistake.

Primary source content: retained191page Census guide actual page161 independently states254Texas counties functioning as government units with Commissioners Courts and distinguishes nongovernmental statistical subdivisions. The250874Bnew navigation HTML is byte-identical to old decoded shell at SHA dbfba8a96dc3cd584157ca66aaafdf67e0ed15dd5a0c8a58f3d4bd0f109fc646; complete nonexecuted HTML text has no cited provision/commissioners-court passage. Original1138explicitly permits restoration-only/unverified constitutional source, so no renewed missing-text dependency or geographic/legal conclusion is imposed. No new datum approximation or fresh geometry measurement is adopted.

Actual protected seven CLI invocations: two independent fresh complete outputs match each other and retained originals; accepted swapped-GEOID andchanged-requestCRS fixtures; existing-output replacement; late missing-GEOID failure with partial overwrite; early duplicate-subject rejection preserving outputs. Reviewed adapter changes only the two exact final output paths and, for controls, the reads of one complete historical-row or retrieval file; original code, source geometries, all other data and baseline history unchanged. Cached Python3.12.14 standard library, bytecode disabled, managed sparse exactmerge review, storage gates, no installation/download/import. Actual unchanged table309836B SHA0ac299d71139bae80567dbde66a05f1863c38acffe4f1a3bf9e6a0935ba9df28; summary3554B SHA31f533b2fb485f71beb34599b343ece2b769d9e0f12f7efc58c10385620bcb45. Ordered whole table+summary concatenation independently matches retained two-run receipt hash ebc61200eb71d4ba38842d5f8c1f457a66adb6a10f73ffec8d24039b607998cc. The original empirical negative control (11multipart counterexamples to the universal one-component claim) is valid for its explicitly stated purpose; do not discard it as a dummy rejection test.

Success criteria:
- One fresh additive integrity erratum under the disjoint owned namespace, at most one PR, exactly254original county IDs. Preserve all #969/#431/#1138 packets/source/code/IDs/parentage/classifications/metrics/claims/dates and this failed-audit-control evidence.
- Authenticate complete actually consumed source/rows/contract/retrieval/metadata/producer bytes to immutable reviewed whole-file pins before computation; no mutable substitutions under unchanged baseline declarations. Verify unique complete subject and native/GEOID joins with independent reference records and relevant identity/name/parent/year fields; parse/validate actual CRS requests and source declarations. Scope rehashing alone is insufficient authority.
- Validate the entire254-row input/join/CRS set before first output mutation. Whole fresh namespace admission and exclusive writes must protect existing results and broken symlinks/path escapes; completion receipt published only after complete independently verified products. Preserve partial failed new products with truthful failure status rather than changing historical output.
- Run actual fresh entry points twice separately; complete per-product/aggregate byte comparisons must bind both products with explicit order/recipe and consumed code/input/execution pins. Preserve correct313component distribution and source-specific CRS/record interpretations. Exercise actual swapped-county-GEOID, modified request CRS, missing-last-GEOID, duplicate-subject and existing-output controls plus independent unchanged positives, with truthful failures and no lost evidence.
- Version1 manifest, exact per-file change receipts, actual metric/control/run bindings and substantive independent exact-head review. No boundary/datum error, island completeness, source-hash-lineage resolution, constitutional authority or publication approval claim.

Dependencies/limits: empty dependencies because every bounded mechanical input is available. Closed1138/431 histories stay closed; #966 owns separate24boundary comparisons/stateoutline, #967 source-hash lineage dependent on954. This does not alter their scope/claims/waits and does not acquire an implementation reservation. Source interpretation is correct on unchanged inputs and actual constitutional text remains explicitly unavailable as permitted. Live Census/Texas HTTP ancestry, independent license adjudication, global Atlas scan and datum displacement remain out of scope; no missing external source is required for this producer correction.

Deduplication: complete authenticated all-state14pages[100×13,63]/945non-PR issues and later affected-packet Git history. No matching repair of the1144producer. Closed1138 completed distinct source/CBF/CRS interpretation, not mutable-input or failure-safe reproduction. Existing1149/1145/1141 cover different Southeastern/EastSouthCentral/SouthAtlantic packets with disjoint ownership, not this Texas program. New namespace disjoint from those and all original Texas paths; Ready only after fresh shared read-only review and guarded issue/dependency/history/ownership readback.
